body:
## Summary Fixes #2492. The solver's GitHub comments said things that were not checked or not true, and repeated what GitHub or the log already show. Every user-facing message was audited. Each changed message now states only what was checked, once, in as few words as possible. Case study (timeline, requirements, root causes, research): [`docs/case-studies/issue-2492/README.md`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2492-f11c7d45f49f/docs/case-studies/issue-2492/README.md) **Evidence from meta-language#196:** 17 comments said "The PR has been converted to draft mode". - **4 were false.** The PR was already a draft and no conversion happened. - **13 repeated GitHub's own `convert_to_draft` timeline event**, posted 1–4 s after it. See [`draft-claims-vs-timeline.tsv`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2492-f11c7d45f49f/docs/case-studies/issue-2492/draft-claims-vs-timeline.tsv). ## Before / after ### 1. Session started (new session) — the reported comment Before: > 🤖 **AI Work Session Started** > > Starting automated work session at 2026-10-04T12:00:55.290Z > > The PR has been converted to draft mode while work is in progress. > > _This comment marks the beginning of an AI work session. Please wait for the session to finish, and provide your feedback._ > > _Runtime: solve `v2.33.11` · tool `claude` · model `opus` · task image `konard/hive-mind-dind:2.33.11@sha256:9994…0288`_ After (the runtime line is added only with `--verbose`; it is always written to the log): > 🤖 **AI Work Session Started** > > Started at 2026-10-04T12:00:55.290Z. Please wait for it to finish before giving feedback. ### 2. Session resumed / auto-resumed / auto-restarted | Before | After | | --- | --- | | Resuming automated work session at X

This session continues from a previous session using the `--resume` flag.

The PR has been converted to draft mode while work is in progress.

_This comment marks the resumption of an AI work session. Please wait for the session to finish, and provide your feedback._ | Resumed at X with `--resume` (previous context kept). Please wait for it to finish before giving feedback. | | Auto-resuming automated work session at X

This session automatically resumed after the usage limit reset, continuing with the previous context preserved.

The PR has been converted to draft mode while work is in progress.

_This is an auto-resumed session. Please wait…_ | Resumed at X after the usage limit reset (previous context kept). Please wait for it to finish before giving feedback. | | Auto-restarting automated work session at X

This session automatically restarted after the usage limit reset (fresh start without previous context).

The PR has been converted to draft mode while work is in progress.

_This is a fresh restart after limit reset. Please wait…_ | Restarted at X after the usage limit reset (fresh context). Please wait for it to finish before giving feedback. | ### 3. Session ended | Before | After | | --- | --- | | Work session ended at X

The PR will be converted back to ready for review.

_This comment marks the end of an AI work session. New comments after this time will be considered as feedback._ | Ended at X. Comments after this one are treated as feedback. | The "converted back to ready for review" promise was not kept after a failed or empty session. ### 4. `--auto-merge` without merge rights (fork / no permission) Posted **before** CI or conflicts were checked, and its "Ready to merge" signature suppressed the real readiness comment later. | Before | After | | --- | --- | | ## ✅ Ready to merge

This pull request is ready to be merged. Auto-merge was requested (`--auto-merge`) but cannot be performed because this PR was created from a fork (no write access to the target repository).

Please merge manually.

---
_hive-mind with --auto-merge flag (fork mode)_ | ## ⚠️ Auto-merge blocked

Auto-merge (`--auto-merge`) cannot merge this pull request because this PR was created from a fork (no write access to the target repository). A maintainer has to merge it. | ### 5. Ready to merge / Auto-merged | Before | After | | --- | --- | | …
- No merge conflicts
- No pending changes

---
_Monitored by hive-mind with --auto-restart-until-mergeable flag_ | …
- No merge conflicts
- No uncommitted changes | | ## 🎉 Auto-merged

This pull request has been automatically merged by hive-mind…

---
_Auto-merged by hive-mind with --auto-merge flag_ | ## 🎉 Auto-merged

This pull request has been automatically merged by hive-mind… | ### 6. Auto-restart | Before | After | | --- | --- | | ## 🔄 Auto-restart 2/5

**Reason:** CI failed

Starting new session to address the issues.

---
_Auto-restart-until-mergeable mode is active. This run will stop after 5 restart iterations in total._ | ## 🔄 Auto-restart 2/5

**Reason:** CI failed

Starting a new session to address it. | | ## 🔄 Auto-restart 1/5

Detected uncommitted changes from previous run. Starting new session to review and commit or discard them.{files}

---
_Auto-restart will stop after changes are committed or discarded, or after 4 more iterations. Please wait until working session will end and give your feedback._ | ## 🔄 Auto-restart 1/5

The previous session left uncommitted changes. Starting a new session to commit or discard them.{files} | | ## ❌ Auto-restart 5/5 - limit reached

Hive Mind stopped after 5/5 automatic restart iterations without resolving the blocker.

**Configured limit:** 5
**Remaining blocker:** CI failed

{preserved work}

No further AI sessions will be started automatically for this run. Review the remaining blocker manually, or rerun with a higher `--auto-restart-max-iterations` value.

---
_This run is reported as failed because the auto-restart limit was reached._ | ## ❌ Auto-restart 5/5 - limit reached

**Remaining blocker:** CI failed

{preserved work}

No more sessions will start automatically. Resolve the blocker, or rerun with a higher `--auto-restart-max-iterations`. | ### 7. Usage limit | Before | After | | --- | --- | | ## ⏳ Usage Limit Reached

The automated solution draft was interrupted because the Claude usage limit was reached.

### 📊 Limit Information
- **Tool**: Claude
- **Limit Type**: Usage limit exceeded
- **Reset Time**: …
- **Session ID**: …

### 🔄 How to Continue
**Auto-resume is enabled.** The session will automatically resume (with context preserved) when the limit resets.
…
---
_This session was interrupted due to usage limits. The session will automatically resume when the limit resets._ | ## ⏳ Usage Limit Reached

The Claude usage limit was reached, so this session stopped.

- **Reset Time**: …
- **Session ID**: …

### 🔄 How to Continue
**Auto-resume is enabled.** The session will resume (previous context kept) when the limit resets.
… | | ⏳ **Usage Limit Reached - Waiting to Continue**

The AI tool has reached its usage limit. auto-resume is enabled.

**Reset time:** …
**Wait time:** …

The session will automatically resume (with context preserved) when the limit resets.

Session ID: `…` | ⏳ **Usage Limit Reached - Waiting to Continue**

**Reset time:** …
**Wait time:** …

The session will resume (previous context kept) when the limit resets.

Session ID: `…` (only when known) | **Bug fixed:** with only `--auto-restart-on-limit-reset`, the run posted "Waiting to Restart" and then exited as failed. The failure-exit check covered only `--auto-resume-on-limit-reset`. It now covers both, so the restart actually happens. ### 8. Session force-killed (stream timeout) When no session id was captured, the retry starts fresh, but the comment promised a resume. | Before | After | | --- | --- | | ## :warning: Session Force-Killed (activity timeout)

The working session was force-killed due to activity timeout (no stream output for 600s).

**Auto-resuming**: Retry 1/3 in 30s. Session will be resumed with `--resume` (context preserved).

_This is an automated notification — the session will continue automatically._ | ## :warning: Session Force-Killed (activity timeout)

No output for 600s, so the session was stopped. Retry 1/3 in 30s, starting fresh (no session to resume). | With a session id: "…Retry 1/3 in 30s, resuming session `abc` (previous context kept)." ### 9. Empty diff | Before | After | | --- | --- | | ⚠️ **No changes produced**

The pull request still has an empty diff against its base branch, so it stays a draft instead of being marked ready for review.

Nothing was implemented, committed or pushed during this working session. Review the session log above for why, then re-run the solver or continue manually. | ⚠️ **No changes produced**

The pull request has an empty diff against its base branch, so it was not marked ready for review. Check the session log for why, then rerun the solver or continue manually. | | PR description: "This pull request implements a solution for #N: title" | PR description with an empty diff: "This pull request is for #N: title. It has no changes yet." | ### 10. Auto-close on failure (`--auto-close-pull-request-on-fail`) | Before | After | | --- | --- | | Auto-closed due to execution failure. Logs have been attached for debugging. | Auto-closed due to execution failure. | The message was posted before, and independently of, the log upload. ### 11. Unclassified pre-PR failure | Before | After | | --- | --- | | ### What you can do
- Resolve the repository, account, permissions, or environment problem described above, then rerun the solver.
- Repository owner or Hive Mind administrator path: handle manual recreation or fix of the repository… (shown even for "Auto-restart limit reached") | ### What you can do
- Check the reason above and the log, then rerun the solver. | ### 12. Working session summary (PR feedback) | Before | After | | --- | --- | | First 16 lines / 1200 characters of the summary, then
`
Rest of the working session summary (1 KB)` with the rest in a `text` block, cut after 3000 more characters | The whole summary, as written. Only a summary over 60000 characters (GitHub rejects comments over 65536) is cut, ending with "N KB more does not fit in a GitHub comment; the full session output is in the session log…" | ### Also fixed The issue-comment log path reported "attached" and returned success without checking the upload result. It now uses the real result. ## Kept on purpose - The "Now working session is ended" footer of the log comment is the feedback-detection marker. - All marker strings are unchanged. - "likely out of memory" is already hedged. See [Audited and kept](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2492-f11c7d45f49f/docs/case-studies/issue-2492/README.md#audited-and-kept). ## How to reproduce Run any solve session on a PR that is already a draft, for example the auto-resume after a usage-limit reset. The start comment says "The PR has been converted to draft mode", and the PR timeline has no `convert_to_draft` event (meta-language#196, comment 5836892716). ## Tests - New `tests/issue-2492-concise-truthful-messages.test.mjs` (default suite) covers: - past tense, no draft claim, no runtime line unless `--verbose`, ≤160 characters for every session type - every new builder, with exact texts - dedup signatures that cannot match each other's comment - the restart-only usage-limit condition - that the removed phrases are gone from the sources - Rewrote `tests/working-session-summary-size-2247.test.mjs`: short, ~40-line and 13 KB summaries are published byte for byte with no `
` fold; only an over-limit summary is cut, with fences closed and the log linked. - Updated `tests/test-issue-2148-auto-resume-reporting.mjs`, `tests/test-activity-timeout-1510.mjs` and `tests/test-solution-summary.mjs` to the new texts. - `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check` and `npm test` pass locally. ### Changes - 29 file(s) modified - 12174 line(s) added - 301 line(s) removed - Files: - `.changeset/concise-truthful-comments.md` - `docs/case-studies/issue-2492/README.md` - `docs/case-studies/issue-2492/draft-claims-vs-timeline.tsv` - `docs/case-studies/issue-2492/meta-language-pr-196-comments.json` - `docs/case-studies/issue-2492/meta-language-pr-196-timeline.json` - `docs/case-studies/issue-2492/screenshot.png` - `src/auto-restart-exhaustion.lib.mjs` - `src/claude.lib.mjs` - `src/github.lib.mjs` - `src/session-force-killed-comment.lib.mjs` - `src/session-runtime-provenance.lib.mjs` - `src/solve.auto-merge-attempt.lib.mjs` - `src/solve.auto-merge-preflight.lib.mjs` - `src/solve.auto-merge.lib.mjs` - `src/solve.error-handlers.lib.mjs` - `src/solve.execution.lib.mjs` - `src/solve.mjs` - `src/solve.pre-pr-failure-notifier.lib.mjs` - `src/solve.results.lib.mjs` - `src/solve.session-comments.lib.mjs` - `src/solve.session.lib.mjs` - `src/solve.watch.lib.mjs` - `src/working-session-summary.lib.mjs` - `tests/critical-error-recovery-keeps-pr-branch-clean-2315.test.mjs` - `tests/issue-2492-concise-truthful-messages.test.mjs` - `tests/test-activity-timeout-1510.mjs` - `tests/test-issue-2148-auto-resume-reporting.mjs` - `tests/test-solution-summary.mjs` - `tests/working-session-summary-size-2247.test.mjs`
title: fix: short, truthful PR comments — past tense, no unchecked draft/merge/log claims, runtime only with --verbose (#2492)
